{{recipe}}

'''Drawn butter''' is a butter-based [[Cookbook:Sauce|sauce]] typically served with [[Cookbook:Lobster|lobster]] or [[Cookbook:Crab|crab]].

==Ingredients==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 8.5 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[cookbook:water|water]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]]s [[cookbook:flour|flour]]
*{{convert|2|oz|g}} unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]

==Procedure==
# Bring the water to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]] in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]].  
# Mix the flour and butter together until they are perfectly smooth. 
# Stir this into the boiling water, and add salt to taste.
